evaluation.primary_gate: Native H1all MAE >=5%better than persistence AND old ME077; H1moving >=5%better than strongest physical persistence/servo/velocity reference; native aggregate scale-free horizon MAE >=2%better than BOTH new matched GRU and Transformer, adjusted paired episode bootstrap upper<0 vsboth; >=4/5seed native wins vs each; no >10%task regression vspersistence; H1stationary MAE <=1.10*same-cohort frozen ME077 stationary MAE.

literature_gap.unresolved_TAConly_question: Does integrated smooth risk-conditioned residual shrinkage preserve actual motion skill while reducing the stationary false corrections exposed by ME078, and can native TAC outperform equally resourced GRU/causal attention under the same improvement opportunity?
literature_gap.what_is_not_being_rediscovered: Gated delta correction, GRU, attention, dense causal multitask supervision, importance weighting and pinball quantiles are established methods, not TAC inventions.
